body_html:
We need to build the Web not use the Web

I can't build the crazy stuff yet, but I am getting good at messing up stuff in new ways. The Web is at a crossroad, and open tools are becoming more diverse. It is time to not just understand the open Web but build the open Web

Philanthropic Entrepreneurial Activism 

That pretty much sums up the Mozillian spirit in my mind.

Everything begins with good design

Iteration is the root of humanity. Mozilla Learning Networks embody this.

Art and Beauty Exist Everywhere

See rule three.
